summary: Proposes an addition to the Bootstrap Protocol (BOOTP), a way to include vendor-specific information. Comments and suggestions were sought. It was replaced by RFC 1084, RFC 1395, RFC 1497 and RFC 1533.

eli5.summary: When a computer starts up and asks for its settings, this adds extra boxes in the answer for things like helpful machines on the network.

questions: what are bootp vendor information extensions
how does bootp give configuration options
